sst.product_name: GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation SST Analysis v4.1 (Monthly)
sst.nasa_platform: GHRSST / 多衛星統合 (MODIS, AVHRR, AMSR-E 等)
sst.processing: regional monthly valid-pixel summary; server-side strided subsample averaged into a 20x26 cell grid; out-of-range values (-2..40) dropped; null kept as null (land decided by region polygons, sea+null = cloud gap)
sst.license_note: NASA data are open. Served via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP; cite both NASA as producer and the ERDDAP distribution path.
